info.title: NoJsonSchema CLI
info.description: Command-line tool that turns JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12 / Draft-07 / OpenAPI 3.x) into zero-dependency C# types and a UTF-8 JSON parser/emitter. Supports remote schema URLs, type whitelisting, value-object record structs, and stream APIs.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate C# code from a JSON Schema.

options.name: --input
options.description: Path or http(s) URL of the JSON Schema. [Required]

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write generated .cs files into. [Required]

options.name: --root-type
options.description: Optional root type name override. [Default: null]

options.name: --type-style
options.description: Type style for objects (Class | Record | ReadonlyRecordStruct). [Default: Class]

options.name: --allof-strategy
options.description: How to represent allOf composition (Inherit | Flatten). [Default: Inherit]

options.name: --strict-extra
options.description: Treat unknown JSON properties as errors.

options.name: --value-object
options.description: Comma-separated list of $defs entries to emit as readonly record struct (primary-ctor) value objects. [Default: null]

options.name: --use-required
options.description: Emit the C# 11 'required' modifier on non-nullable required properties (otherwise '= null!' is used to suppress CS8618).

options.name: --include-type
options.description: Comma-separated whitelist of $defs / components.schemas entries to generate (transitive deps included automatically). Default is everything. [Default: null]

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Parse a schema and report structural problems without generating code.

options.name: --input
options.description: Path or http(s) URL of the JSON Schema. [Required]
